description: Complete the production Spark Declarative Pipelines code for MegaMart's order processing.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this code will:
1. Parameterize the pipeline for dev/staging/prod environments
2. Configure Auto Loader for bronze ingestion
3. Apply CDC with apply_changes() for silver updates
4. Enforce quality checks before gold layer
5. Route failures to a dead letter queue
hints: pipeline.env is the standard pipeline configuration parameter
sequence_by ensures events are applied in chronological order
Gold aggregations use dp.read() (batch) not read_stream()
max(updated_at) tracks data freshness in Gold tables
dead_letter naming convention makes it clear these are error records
learnings: keys= specifies the merge key columns
dp.expect_or_fail() halts the pipeline on critical violations
Dead-letter tables route failures for inspection
